verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own configurable logic: users can configure the risk-score equation and create multiple screening configurations. Its agentic workflows automatically escalate high-risk cases and auto-remediate level 1 alerts, and WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks fire on screening events. However, the evidence shows no general user-authored rule builder linking event conditions to arbitrary actions, and Starter-plan configuration cannot be customized. Missing for 10: documented user-defined event→condition→action rule engine, user control over which automated actions fire, independent or hands-on corroboration.
